key_insight: PP-VarQITE determines thermal-state circuit parameters entirely classically, encoding temperature in the angles of a fixed, shallow quantum circuit.
engineering_relevance: Shallower circuits reduce quantum hardware execution demands and enable low-temperature state preparation beyond the practical reach of statevector simulation.
method: Combine Pauli propagation with variational quantum imaginary-time evolution.
Compute circuit parameters classically for different target temperatures.
Execute fixed-architecture circuits on trapped-ion quantum hardware.
evidence_signal: Numerical studies reached 100 qubits with circuits approximately 2–10× shallower than the lowest-depth sequential tensor-network compilations; Helios experiments used 96 and 98 qubits, with the lattice circuits requiring at most 42 two-qubit layers.
watch_item: The reported benchmarks do not establish classical parameter-computation costs or accuracy for arbitrary models and lower temperatures.
paper_title: Thermal state preparation with shallow quantum circuits
